meta.source: farmers.json (matched records) + Baseline Report (Jaykar) anchored rates
meta.methodology: Hybrid: source flags for varying data (gender, caste, land, age, marital, hasToilet, migration, bankAccount); Baseline Report rates (Section B) with deterministic seeded RNG for uniform-true flags (BPL, Antodyaya, MGNREGA, E-Shram).
meta.baselineRatesSource: Baseline Report - Jaykar.md Section B; baseline_nrm.json
meta.note: BPL 100% in source data is a data-quality artefact (bpl:true AND apl:true on every record). Replaced with Baseline Report rate (64.6%) using seeded RNG for reproducibility.
